name: Mustache
comment: A dmx template is Dart with Mustache tags in it [editor.template-highlighting]. The Dart half is the installed Dart grammar, so it stays correct as Dart does; the Mustache half is injected by mustache-tags.injection.tmLanguage.json, which outranks the Dart rules and so still lights up a tag written inside a Dart string literal. With no Dart grammar installed, the tags highlight and the rest stays plain text.
